Feature.title: Solutions that transform how you use your data.
Feature.description: Our services are focused on getting you good results. That's why we adapt to your needs and to the state of your information.

items.title: Data Analytics and Reporting
items.desc: We build simple and complex, scalable and automated data models that surface useful information to track your main business indicators. Models are built from SQL databases, spreadsheet files such as Excel or Sheets, or web APIs.

items.title: Optimization and reengineering
items.desc: If your company already has a BI development that doesn't perform well or can't deliver the information you need, based on our experience we can identify improvement opportunities such as technical or performance issues, and apply solutions to optimize models.

items.title: Maintenance and personalized support
items.desc: An exclusive maintenance and technical assistance service that includes help and training for the people who use the platform, to build long-term relationships with our clients.

items.title: Business Intelligence Outsourcing (OBI)
items.desc: No specialized team? No problem. OBI is a service designed to delegate your information processing needs to our team of specialized professionals.

blocks.title: Data Analytics and Reporting
blocks.intro: We turn complex data into clear, actionable information, driving more strategic decisions and boosting your performance.
blocks.provides: To do so, Be Data provides:
blocks.highlightDesc: We build simple and complex, scalable and automated data models that surface useful information to track your main business indicators. Models are built from SQL databases, spreadsheet files such as Excel or Sheets, or web APIs.

blocks.title: Optimization and Reengineering
blocks.intro: Thanks to our experience and a systematic, analytical approach, we help organizations redesign their processes, eliminate inefficiencies and maximize the use of resources.
blocks.highlightDesc: Through a detailed analysis of existing processes we identify bottlenecks, redundancies and areas for improvement in information integration. We use techniques such as process mapping and workflow analysis to get a clear view of the current state.

blocks.title: Business Intelligence Outsourcing (OBI)
blocks.intro: Our outsourcing service lets you externalize key tasks of your business, delegating processes to a team of experts so you can focus on your core activities. OBI focuses on specialized areas such as data analysis, IT and more, guaranteeing:
blocks.highlightDesc: Through our Outsourcing team your requests and concerns will be handled quickly, working as if they were part of your company. We adapt our communication to yours. For good collaboration, our team works alongside yours.
bullets: Resource optimization and reduced operating costs.

blocks.title: Maintenance and Personalized Support
blocks.intro: Technical assistance and advice complementing every Be Data solution. But not only that.
blocks.highlightDesc: For users of the platforms we develop, so they can get the best performance from our products.

AboutPage.title: About us
AboutPage.p1: A young professional team that believes in the potential of data to transform the world. We created Be Data after many years working at other companies, to offer what the market needed: a service tailored to the client, that stays by their side and constantly improves.
AboutPage.p2: Our goal is to help companies exploit their data to obtain valuable information and support their growth.

team.name: Gabriel Gilli
team.role: Microsoft Certified Power BI Data Analyst Associate.

team.name: Ale Maldonado
team.bio: Specialist in data analysis and project development with Microsoft Power BI and SQL. DAX and M. Complex models. Performance and optimization. Our BI consultant and Storytelling specialist at Be Data.

AboutPage.methodTitle: Our work methodology lets us achieve it.

steps.title: Client
steps.desc: Definition of data sources. Appointment of the business Product Owner. Granting of credentials. Setting priorities and describing information needs.

steps.title: Factory
steps.desc: Development planning. Source connection, modeling, normalization and transformation of data. Dashboard development and publishing to PBI Service. Gateway setup and scheduled refresh.

steps.title: Presentation
steps.desc: Periodic meetings to follow up on the project and present progress. Receiving feedback and re-works. Setting weekly goals.

AboutPage.differentTitle: WE TURN SIMPLE DATA INTO VALUABLE INFORMATION
AboutPage.differentDesc: What makes us different is what we deliver to our clients in each of our services:

values.title: User focus
values.desc: Our clients are also the ones who will use the platforms we develop. That's why we program and design each platform according to their style and needs.

values.title: Functionality first
values.desc: Every platform must be simple to use, fast in motion and analytical in its results.

values.title: Fluid communication
values.desc: It is the basis we consider essential to build the future and how we want data to be conveyed.

values.title: Good practices
values.desc: To improve analysis and good use of information we teach how to use each platform correctly and how to get the most from the results.

values.title: Unique corporate design
values.desc: Identity matters. That's why we give a unique design to the platform your company will use.
